name: Hyperspectral Image Classification Benchmark
description: Provides datasets and standardized evaluations for hyperspectral image classification methods.
evaluation_method: overall accuracy (OA), per-class accuracy, and Kappa coefficient
typical_sota_score: varies by dataset; commonly reported OA in the range ~85–99%
reputation: A well-known standardized benchmark suite in the remote sensing / hyperspectral imaging community used to compare classification methods.
notes: Datasets are often small and spatially correlated (e.g., Indian Pines, Pavia), making train/test split protocols and class imbalance important caveats; evaluation can be sensitive to preprocessing and splitting strategy; non-LLM benchmark.
